# Voice guide

## Principles

### Talk like a dispatcher

Short sentences, the way a dispatcher talks on the radio. "Crew two is twenty minutes out."

## Words we use and avoid

We say crew, never team. We say dispatch board, never platform.

## By channel

Email subject lines are under eight words and never ask a question.
